apiKey.question: How do I get an API key?
apiKey.answer: You can get API keys directly from OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), or Google (Gemini) websites. Each provider offers their own pricing.

cost.question: How much do API keys cost?
cost.answer: API costs vary by provider and usage. Typically, casual users spend $5-20/month, much less than subscription services.

languages.question: Which languages are supported?
languages.answer: We support 23 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more.

privacy.question: Is my data safe?
privacy.answer: Yes! Your API keys are stored locally in your browser. Translations go directly to AI providers without passing through our servers.

browsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
browsers.answer: Currently Chrome and Edge. Firefox and Safari support coming soon.
